summary: E2E test of org-chart additions to Roles module: Levels CRUD entity + Role level_id/dotted_parent_id/order fields + OrgChart swimlane visualization. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (Levels CRUD w/ 409 dup, sorted by order; delete level detaches roles.level_id -> null; role create/update accepts level_id+dotted_parent_id+order and returns them; invalid level_id -> 400 'Level not found'; dotted_parent_id == self -> 400; nonexistent dotted_parent_id -> 400; deleting role B clears role A.dotted_parent_id if it referenced B). Frontend: verified via Playwright - Roles page shows new 'Level' + 'Order' table columns; Levels button opens Manage Levels dialog and add/edit/delete + duplicate-name error toast all work; Add Role form has role-level-select combobox + role-order-input, created role row shows level name + order; Structure button opens org-chart dialog rendering swimlanes (org-lane-{levelId}) and role nodes (org-node-{roleId}) grouped by level with a 'No level' lane for unassigned. Legend shows Direct/Dotted-line superior. Toast, dialog close, cleanup all functional. No production data modified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: unique index on levels.name is created at startup — if DB ever contains duplicate level names (from a partial migration) the index creation will raise. Consider wrapping in try/except with a warning like offices.
server.py delete_level does not check for existence before update_many; DELETE returns 404 correctly only via delete_one deleted_count check — fine.

OrgChart.jsx: max-count-based centering computes contentW from the widest lane; when a lane has many nodes (>10) the SVG becomes very wide (min-w-max) — acceptable since parent DialogBody scrolls horizontally, but could add a zoom/fit control later.

OrgChart path() falls back to a center-to-center straight line when parent's swimlane is not strictly above the child's — this can happen for dotted-line references crossing lanes non-linearly; visually acceptable but could look messy in dense charts.
RolesPage NONE='__none__' sentinel repeated across parent/dotted/level Combobox; consider a small helper. Non-blocking.
levels endpoint has no PATCH-style partial validation for order < 0 (LevelUpdate.order has no ge=0). Not a correctness bug (nulls handled), but negative order would sort ahead of everything. Minor.
test_credentials: Frontend mock: user@example.com / password. Backend: no auth.
